head.t: Advanced Bionics wins £1.7m cochlear implant managed-service deal at Guy's and St Thomas'
head.x: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded Advanced Bionics UK Limited a managed service programme supporting its cochlear implant patients, covering maintenance, repair, replacement and consumables plus technical support and spares.
